name: Training and Education
purpose: GRI 404: Training and Education 2016 contains disclosures for organizations to report information about their training and education-related impacts, and how they manage these impacts. The Standard is structured as follows: • Section 1 contains a requirement, which provides information about how the organization manages its training and education-related impacts. • Section 2 contains three disclosures, which provide information about the organization’s training and education- related impacts. •
